name: A. O. Smith
description: A. O. Smith makes residential and commercial water heaters (tank, tankless, heat pump), boilers (Lochinvar) and water treatment products. It says it is the largest water heater maker in North America, selling mainly through about 800 independent wholesale plumbing distributors under the A. O. Smith and State brands, and through home centers and manufacturer reps. About 77 percent of 2025 sales ($3.83B) are North America; the rest is largely China (18 percent of sales, shrinking as subsidy programs ended) plus India and Europe. Water heaters are a replacement-driven product: most units are bought when an old heater fails, which gives steady recurring demand, helped by efficiency regulation.

businessLines.how: One-time sale of units to wholesale plumbing distributors, home centers and, for boilers, manufacturer representatives; most demand is replacement when an old heater or boiler fails, so volumes track the installed base, with price and mix (condensing, tankless, heat pump) moving results.
businessLines.description: Residential and commercial water heaters, boilers and related parts, and water treatment products sold in the US and Canada.
